camel_example: aliyun cms CreateSiteMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --Address 'https://www.aliyun.com' --TaskName HanZhou_ECS1 --TaskType HTTP
kebab_example: aliyun cms create-site-monitor --address https://www.aliyun.com --task-type HTTP --task-name HanZhou_ECS1 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSiteMonitor

parameters.help_en: The URL or IP address to monitor
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en:
The type of monitoring task.

Valid protocols include HTTP(S), PING, TCP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, POP3, FTP, and WEBSOCKET
parameters.help_zh:
监控任务的监控类型。

目前站点监控任务的类型包括：HTTP（S）、PING、TCP、UDP、DNS、SMTP、POP3、FTP、WEBSOCKET
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the monitoring task.

The name must be 4 to 100 characters long and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
监控任务的名称。

长度4~100个字符，取值可包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和汉字
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The monitoring frequency in minutes.

Valid values: 1, 5, 15, 30, and 60.

Default: 1
parameters.help_zh:
监控频率。

取值：1分钟、5分钟、15分钟、30分钟和60分钟。

默认值：1分钟
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The detection points. If you do not specify this parameter, the system randomly selects three detection points from different Internet Service Providers (ISPs).

The value must be a JSON array. Example: `[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`. The values correspond to Beijing, Hangzhou, and Qingdao.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115045.html
parameters.help_zh:
探针信息。如果该参数取值为空，则系统随机选择3个探测点。

格式为JSONArray，例如：`[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`，分别对应北京、杭州、青岛。

关于如何获取探测点信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115045.html
parameters.name: isp_cities

parameters.help_en: The advanced options for the specified protocol. The available options vary based on the protocol type
parameters.help_zh: 监控任务对应协议类型的高级扩展选项。不同监控任务的协议类型对应不同的扩展选项
parameters.name: options_json

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert rule.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警规则ID。

关于如何获取云监控中已存在的报警规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114941.html
parameters.name: alert_ids

parameters.help_en: The group of detection points for the network probe task. \`PC\` indicates detection points on PCs. \`MOBILE\` indicates detection points on mobile devices. \`FC\` indicates detection points in a VPC. The default value is \`PC\`
parameters.help_zh: 拨测任务使用的拨测点组。不同的选项对应不同的探测点类型。PC对应PC端，MOBIEL对应移动端，FC对应VPC内网探测。不设置的话默认为PC
parameters.name: agent_group

parameters.help_en: The custom detection schedule. Specify a time period and the days of the week for detection
parameters.help_zh: 自定义探测周期。只能选择周一至周日的某个时间段进行探测
parameters.name: custom_schedule

parameters.help_en: The network information required to create a network probe task in a VPC. This must be a JSON object that contains the \`vpcId\`, \`vswitchId\`, \`securityGroupId\`, and \`region\` fields
parameters.help_zh: 创建vpc内网拨测任务时需要提供的网络信息。需要提供一个JSON，里边必须包含vpcId，vswitchId，securityGroupId和region四个字段
parameters.name: vpc_config

Code.description_en:
The status code of the operation.

A value of \`200\` indicates success

Data.description_en: The results of the monitoring task

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
